# 164 Camps on the 7:00–8:00 sector — Black Rock City 2026

Camp placements are official Burning Man Project data and may be shown to users from Aug 23 12:01am (the dataset terms lift the camp-location embargo then; this release ships Aug 27). Playa Pal is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or verified by Burning Man Project.

## 7 Sirens Cove

**Where:** 7:00 & A · **From:** SF Bay Area · **Landmark:** Pirate Ship and lit dome · **Year:** 2026

A pirate bohemia since 2011 where merrymaking, mermaid lounging, dancing rhythms and mischief run aground. Beware, it is futile to resist the 7 Siren's call!

*More: http://www.7sirenscove.com*

## 8-bit Bunny

**Where:** 7:00 & E · **From:** Oakland · **Landmark:** Giant pixel bunny · **Year:** 2026

Our steam sauna is open every day. Sweet out the dust and leave cleaner than you have ever been on playa. Feeling adventurous? Spin the wheel at our bar for a drink. Rabbit ears encouraged, but not required.

*More: https://burn.8bitbunny.com/*

**Where:** D & 7:15 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** & sign · **Year:** 2026

## AdramaNation

**Where:** C & 7:15 · **From:** New Orleans · **Landmark:** Pink flower topped poles at the front & pink tent · **Year:** 2026

An all inclusive and diverse camp focusing on a drama free and fun filled burn. Delicious delicacies, hydration, art, weddings, burnercise, and good company are to be found with us. Whether you need a safe space to escape your drama or a place to meet new friends, you're always welcome here.

*More: https://camp-adramanation.squarespace.com/*

## And Then There's Only Love

**Where:** 7:30 & F · **From:** Las Vegas · **Landmark:** 1 white dome, 2 circus tent with orgy dome signage · **Year:** 2026

Home of the world famous Orgy Dome — where couples & moresomes of all orientations are invited to come and play. We welcome the combination of love in all forms. We're a sex-positive, inclusionary, and exploratory space that's been a place of fire, fun, and passion since 2003. Everyone wishing to enter the Orgy Dome receives a detailed orientation covering Informed Enthusiastic Consent. Remember, anything other than an enthusiastic YES means NO! Our (relatively) dust free and air conditioned space is designed for people to experience social sexuality in a safe and respectful way. We have a 'Just Us' and an 'Open to More' section — so monogamous & non-monogamous folks are all welcome.

*More: https://andthentheresonlylove.com/*

## ANTIIX

**Where:** E & 7:45 · **From:** Sacramento · **Landmark:** Front Lit Lanterns and Bar with Flat top Deck · **Year:** 2026

ANTIIX where we are Anti-Icks and always up for kicks. A Shady place to meet for drinks, laughs, chats, music, who knows what else!

*More: https://www.facebook.com/groups/1448340276823014/*

## ArtSled

**Where:** D & 7:45 · **From:** Salt Lake City · **Landmark:** Glowing large sphere with colorful lights at front · **Year:** 2026

Step into a glowing spherical space where creativity and community come alive. Sip tea from a samovar, grab a pencil or marker, and join in collaborative drawing or live karaoke. DJ sets and music fill the air, inviting everyone to dance, relax, or simply enjoy the shared energy. Our camp is open to all, encouraging participation, playful exploration, and connection. Whether you're here to create, perform, or just soak in the vibe, there's a spot for you in our interactive hub.

## Atom Cult

**Where:** E & 7:45 · **From:** San Diego · **Landmark:** A 30' pole illuminated by moving LED lights · **Year:** 2026

Cool yourself down with a variety of Fission Ice Cream offerings at noon! Get lost in our Garden of Lost Apparatus! Relax and recharge both yourself and your portable electronics in our Reactor Dome!

*More: http://www.atomcult.com/*

## Awesomesauce

**Where:** 7:30 B Plaza @ 5:00 · **Landmark:** Fuchsia Pink frontage · **Year:** 2026

We are a Unicorn ranch decorated in bright fuchsia pink, lights and unicorns. We run an afternoon and early evening bar, called The unStable, serving our unique 'Unicorn Tears' and a dress up bar. We also host daily events such as Square Dancing, Advice, & Crafting.

*More: http://www.campawesomesauce.org*

## Awkward & Tawdry Lounge

**Where:** Esplanade & 7:15 · **From:** Sacramento · **Landmark:** Starlit Bar and Shoot Your Balls Off · **Year:** 2026

Part bar. Part lounge. Part sing. Part dance. Part chill. Part Shoot Your Balls Off. 100% Awkward & Tawdry.

## BAAAHS Station

**Where:** 7:00 & F · **From:** San Franciscio · **Landmark:** 30' tall glowing art deco tower · **Year:** 2026

We're the home of BAAAHS: the Big-Ass Amazingly Awesome Homosexual Sheep. You might know us as the 40-foot long rolling disco whose entrance, naturally, is through the pulsing pink sphincter in the rear. Day and night, we graze on the playa...laser eyeballs shining, beloved DJs spinning, dancy people flocking. BAAAHS Station is our central depot where everyone is welcome to kick up your hooves. Come for our daily dance parties, get a view from our four-story watchtower, enjoy a lovely beverage from our friendly bartenders, and meet a homo or two. We're builders, artists, and techies at heart. Our DJ line-up combines world-famous names with up-and-cumming performers, with a focus on featuring queer artists. Our mission - Shear queer bliss.

*More: http://baaahs.org*

## Backfire

**Where:** 7:00 & B · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Large LED "BACKFIRE" sign. · **Year:** 2026

A small camp composed of ASL signers that loves to bring a little bit of their community and experience to the citizens of Black Rock City! We have Vietnamese Coffee and ASL every morning, along with our popular Lil Fixit Shop if you have something that needs fixing. Or come by in the afternoon to check out our ASL confessional booth!

*More: https://backfire.camp*

## Bad Asstronauts

**Where:** 7:30 B Plaza @ 9:45 · **From:** Denver, San Francisco · **Landmark:** LED Rocket Beacon · **Year:** 2026

The Bad Asstronauts are an Earth-based collective with stations in Denver and San Francisco. We will take care of all your musical and libation needs. Our DJs will blow your mind with electrifying beats on our upgraded sound system to bring you an incredible new audio and visual experience. Quench your thirst with our extraordinary elixirs crafted by our skilled mixologists at the Moontang Bar. Step into our chill lounge, the Planetarium, where you can find tranquility while gazing at celestial wonders projected above. We look forward to continuing to be the best gateway to the galaxy on playa since 2015.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/thebadasstronauts/*

## Bat Haus

**Where:** D & 7:45 · **From:** Vallejo · **Landmark:** Bat Haus camp sign, purple and black bunting · **Year:** 2026

Art support camp

*More: https://www.facebook.com/BatHausArt/*

## Betty's Bike Shop

**Where:** C & 7:45 · **From:** Federal Way - Auburn · **Landmark:** Betty's Shop Sign on Front of 20x20 White Tent · **Year:** 2026

Bring your broken bike to our camp and With Consent we will help you get to a Happy Ending. We want you Fixed so you can return that familiar and intimate friend back where it belongs. Right Between your legs! A functional Playa Bike; now that's a Happy Ending! Limited Hours of Happiness so Cum Early for Best Results.

*More: http://burnerbikesurvival.com*

## Beverly Grillz

**Where:** 7:30 B Plaza @ 7:45 · **From:** New York City · **Landmark:** "BEVERLY GRILLZ" marquee illuminated sign · **Year:** 2026

The playa's home for exotic meats and wacky beatz. We believe in radical inclusion and invite you to participate in our love and nourishment.

## Bioluminati (Bike Mutation)

**Where:** D & 7:45 · **From:** Grass Valley · **Landmark:** Bike Mutation Signage · **Year:** 2026

Unadorned cyclists beware-- The Style Enforcement Officers will be back in person in the dust to issue citations for kinetic-aesthetic violations! But fear not: the Bioluminati Bike Mutation Station - is THE destination for bicycle decoration and transformation. We gift all manner of non-moopagenic materials and accoutrements for mutating your mobile mount into something magnificent! We are open Monday through Friday from 11-2ish hosting interactive bike decorating activities. We have a spray paint area, lots of duct tape, toys, dolls, barbies, non-moopy materials, all helping to make the playa a more fun and colorful place to be! On Tuesday night, we will have a night bike DANCE PARTY!! with lights to decorate bikes and a DJ On Saturday a.m. we will be having a bike mutation ride parade!

*More: https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=100077392066948*

## Black Rock City Municipal Pool

**Where:** 7:00 & C · **From:** Fire Island Pines · **Landmark:** Membership Services office & 16ft towers with sign · **Year:** 2026

Looking for a place to cool down and relax? The Black Rock City Municipal Pool might be the place for you! There's something for everyone: come by for a refreshment and shady misting during one of our Open Swim sessions, swing through at night for a bit of poolside lounging in peace, or put your dancing boots to good use at our Spring Break party! Access to our Spa is supposed to only be available for members, so stop by our Membership Office and fill out your application. Want to book the pool for your next event? Reach out with a request and let's make a splash together!

*More: https://www.brcmunicipalpool.com/*

## Black Rock Roller Disco

**Where:** Esplanade & 7:00 · **From:** San Fancisco, California · **Landmark:** Golden Gate Bridge · **Year:** 2026

Every city has a roller skating rink. The Black Rock Roller Disco is the roller skating rink for Blac Rock City. We ae a full service roller rink. We have the skates, the funky music and we're always a funky good time every time.

*More: http://www.churchof8wheels.com/BlackRockRollerDisco.htm*

## Bone Voyage

**Where:** F & 7:45 · **From:** Walnut Creek · **Landmark:** Four 30ft flag poles: black flag and mammoth skull · **Year:** 2026

Welcome to the official backstage hub for the Bone Voyage mutant vehicle! While our vessel is out cruising the dust, our support camp serves as the critical base to refuel and keep the gears turning. We don't host public events in camp, as our gift to Black Rock City is entirely mobile and out on the open playa. However, if you spot our Mammoth Skull Flags or our Bony Bus, give us a wave...we're probably just gearing up for another wild expedition!

*More: https://www.instagram.com/the.bone.voyage*

## Booty Worship

**Where:** 7:30 & C · **From:** Berkeley · **Landmark:** Illuminated duxel tower and Booty sign · **Year:** 2026

Allow us to worship you. Your ass is our asset. Booty Worship is a place where you can: Feel safe to be exactly as you are Explore your edges Embrace your queerness Move your divine, sexy body

*More: https://instagram.com/bootyworshipbrc*

## Branding & Booze

**Where:** 7:00 & B · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Bright blue shade structure, Branding&Booze sign · **Year:** 2026

Bring your own leather and leave with a piece of playa-forged art! Use our cattle irons to brand or our stamping machine to stamp Burning Man-related images (like the man or city map)! We will have pre-cut leather for those without an item to bring. Enjoy our homemade liquors, chill in our shade, listen to our music, and play our Barn Games. Look for bright blue shade!

## Bubble Lounge

**Where:** 7:30 B Plaza @ 3:45 · **From:** Gerlach · **Landmark:** 3 story scaffolding with Bubble Lounge sign · **Year:** 2026

A queer-forward, wildly inclusive, bar and chill zone celebrating 27 years on playa. Featuring DJ tower, interactive dance structure, vibrantly lit body wash experience, a chill lounge, and secret room (SSSH!) where you can find reprieve from the chaos. Expect music, mischief, bubbly, and a caring group of folk in equal measure.

*More: https://thebubblelounge.net*

## BUBBLEGASM

**Where:** F & 7:15 · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** 2 white shade structures with BUBBLEGASM banners · **Year:** 2026

Bubblegasm is a mutant vehicle built to spread the joy of bubbles and lights with all those who ride on her or dance and play around her. Bubbles are a metaphor for life, fleeting and fragile and are a reminder about how precious our time is while we are here, and to make the most of each moment. And like each bubble, each person and their life is beautiful and unique. Bubbles are also temporary and once they pop they become part of the universe, just as we do when we die. When people encounter bubbles it is a like a rare moment of magic. They symbolize our childhood innocence, reminding us of a time when life was simple and carefree. When we see these glass-like orbs dancing in the air they remind us to live in the moment, let go, dance with a stranger, be silly - have a bubblegasm!

**Where:** F & 7:45 · **From:** Toronto · **Landmark:** Bungalow sign and orange velvet couches · **Year:** 2026

## Burning Band Camp

**Where:** Esplanade & 7:00 · **From:** CORVALLIS · **Landmark:** Burning Band flags · **Year:** 2026

This is the home of the itinerant Burning Band, here to provide you with an earful of music. Well, two earfuls, really...

## Burntown

**Where:** 7:30 G Plaza @ 9:45 · **From:** Auburn · **Landmark:** 100ft long rope bridge. · **Year:** 2026

Don't call it a comeback, we been here for years! Burntown is back again ready to ROCK the playa. Come try the Rope Bridge of DEATH. Savor many exotic tobacco and herbal snuff varieties in our SNUFF Emporium. Shop for that special something in our General Store. Relax and enjoy our Art Gallery, which will have all sorts of artwork and guest speakers throughout the week. At Burntown, expect the unexpected!

## Camp [No Name]

**Where:** E & 7:15 · **From:** Santa Cruz · **Landmark:** Street bar w/ mesh siding & camp sign on top · **Year:** 2026

An international camp hosting DJs, yoga, workshops, theme parties, a bar for the thirsty, cozy lounging, bar games and flogging/kink dungeon. Specializing in dubious advice and questionable antics.

*More: http://thecampwithno.name*

## Camp Babe

**Where:** 7:30 & H · **From:** Asheville, NC · **Landmark:** "BABE" sign, 4' tall letters, purple and pink, lit · **Year:** 2026

CAMP BABE is a collection of curious, universal, space-time travelers on a sparkly journey through the cosmos. Our chariot is a shooting star (hailing from the dense star nebula surrounding planet B4B3) and we come bearing wonderful and exotic gifts for the denizens of the intergalactic hub that is Black Rock City, Earth.

We can't be bothered to fill this out.

**Where:** C & 7:45 · **From:** Boulder · **Landmark:** Entrance 8' Diameter LED ring you can walk through · **Year:** 2026

Art support camp that loves to share their love of creating art

## Camp Cosmo

**Where:** D & 7:15 · **From:** Salt Lake City · **Landmark:** CAMP COSMO flag · **Year:** 2026

We are a tribe of global citizens who come together to create a Cosmopolitan playground. We provide Photo Booth and 360 degree rotating selfie platform from Tuesday to Friday between 1--4pm. You can use your own phone or camera to capture epic Burning Man inspired photos and videos. And of course we have the music, photo gifts and cold drinks. Come express yourself, get creative ,and take some unforgettable moments. so come and join us!

## Camp Darling

**Where:** C & 7:15 · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** Irish flag, pride flag, and Camp Darling sign · **Year:** 2026

Our camp's mission and mantra is to provide a space for decadent, wine-soaked, slightly feral joy. Come enjoy allergen-friendly charcuterie and wine in our shaded picnic space while connecting, sharing stories, enjoying the sunset with old and/or new friends, and keeping it gay. A bacchanal of frivolity, deliciousness, and delight. It's camp, darling.

## Camp Home

**Where:** 7:30 Portal · **From:** Crestline, CA · **Landmark:** Make-A-Thing station and Camp Home signage · **Year:** 2026

Just your friendly neighbors next door. We are here to provide creature comforts ? cold booze, hot tea, mist and buffer massages. Whether it be a piping hot midnight cup of custom blended tea, or a citrusy boozy creation while you briefly escape that blazing playa sunshine, we are here for you. We will keep you cozy with the comforts of home. Let's get weird and stay magical.

## Camp Morning Wood

**Where:** E & 7:45 · **From:** Denver · **Landmark:** Camp Morning Wood hanging sign · **Year:** 2026

Welcome to Camp Morning Wood! Which is, quite simply, your friendly, neighborhood, summer camp-themed, saloon. Starting fresh each morning at 10:00 a.m. to "Eye of the Tiger" we're there to motivate the neighborhood, to attack a new day (after licking our wounds from the night before). CMW is ready to greet you with a smile, music, dancing, or maybe just a view of the city from our raised platform. From sunrise to sunset (and beyond), you can almost always pull up a barstool for some friendly conversation, and an ice cold (hard or soft) beverage.

## Camp O-Wow

**Where:** C & 7:45 · **From:** London England · **Landmark:** Camp O-Wow Flags and Candy Floss Machine · **Year:** 2026

Come and enter a snippet of London and gaze at the stars and play a game of checkers or croquet whist enjoying cool shade and great company. Also grab a stick and make a mouthwatering S'more!

## Camp P3

**Where:** E & 7:45 · **From:** Denver and Salt Lake · **Landmark:** Priscilla RV and camp name signs at the bar front · **Year:** 2026

Join us as we spiral ever outward in unending discovery of where the highway of radial participation intersects with the great canal of radical inclusion. Camp P3 is 'be your best self' boutique clothing gifters, and Nitro Coffee moguls hell bent on emblazoning your brain. We are also simply the hosts of the world's largest white Wedding Dress Wednesday procession complete with a mass wedding ceremony? Don't ask us, we don't even know what our camp name means? Perhaps it means something different to each of us. Come visit us and find out what P3 means to you.

## Camp Pendant

**Where:** C & 7:15 · **From:** PLACENTIA · **Landmark:** 9 tall penants mostly red, black, & white · **Year:** 2026

Welcome one and all! Come by and decorate one of this year's pendants or pick-up a "BURNER" bike license plate. Rest your weary feet and tell us about your year. Place yourself on the world map. Be sure to check out the day's swag on our gifting tree. Whether you take a little something or leave a little something, it's here to make everyone's day a little brighter.

## Camp Piper

**Where:** B & 7:45 · **From:** Amsterdam · **Landmark:** flag with Camp Piper on it · **Year:** 2026

A ragtag group of international babes who all appreciate the elegant screeching and sophisticated whine of the bagpipe. Currently seeking a bagpipe player! Our camp was founded in 2014 when most of us (being virgin burners) stranded on the playa at the same place, same time. We all woke up to the beautiful sound of the bagpipe. Every since we have been warming wandering souls on the Playa. Stop by for a drink, a hug, and a belly laugh. Sparkles, y'all!

## Camp Shutterbuggy

**Where:** E & 7:15 · **From:** Vancouver · **Landmark:** Infinity Mirror Dance Pavilion · **Year:** 2026

Your neighborhood interactive art exhibit with music and drinks each night from 8pm to 12am. We have not one, but TWO of the world's coolest dance poles. Stop by for a spin!

*More: https://www.facebook.com/groups/Shutterbuggy*

## Camp Sweaty Betty

**Where:** C & 7:15 · **From:** Boise · **Landmark:** Blue dome w/ camp sign · **Year:** 2026

Can't tell which is dustier - body, mind, or soul? It's probably your hair. Friendly neighborhood hair washing salon - stop in and get yo'self correct head to foot - hell, bring a partner and we can teach them how, too. Plenty of gossip, probably a little therapy. Open Monday - Friday 11:00 am - 3:00 pm

## Casa de la Rumba

**Where:** 7:30 & E · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** The word CASINO in big red letters with lights. · **Year:** 2026

The most magical prohibition era Casino where you can enjoy our whimsical cocktails while trying your luck at our roulette, Blackjack or Craps table, all under our glorious circus tent. Come get some rumba to our Casa. Celebrate sharing, life, and try your luck in our little casino. You can come and bet whatever you have on you and we will match it up. Be prepared to walk in a different time and space once you step into our 20s Casino. There will be a smile in your face when you leave. Guaranteed or we give you your money back!

*More: https://casadelarumba.com*

## Celestial Alchemy

**Where:** Esplanade & 7:30 Portal · **From:** Denver · **Landmark:** Colorful signs that are placed in front of camp · **Year:** 2026

The practice of inner transformation and parallels with the cosmic realms, a diverse camp that celebrates the love and connection of a transcendent humanity. Join us for 10 Principle themed heartfelt yoga and conscious breathwork to revitalize your Burn spirit. We gift cold tea and herbal elixirs for your sweet pleasure. Our celestial moon art piece is visible during dusk and early nighttime, accompanied by soft beats and easeful smiles. We look forward to morning movement and moonlit kisses with you.

## Celestial Bodies

**Where:** 7:30 G Plaza @ 4:30 · **From:** Sacramento · **Landmark:** Large bar blue walls with space scenes on panels. · **Year:** 2026

For 22 years, Celestial Bodies has been your friendly, all inclusive, gay bar on the playa. Brining you fun, daily events in a welcoming environment.

*More: http://www.campcelestialbodies.org*

## Cheezy Oasis

**Where:** 7:00 & E · **From:** Las Vegas · **Landmark:** neon camp name and purple sheeting · **Year:** 2026

Indulge in the tantalizing allure of irresistibly cheezy goodness that delicately melts in your mouth. Join us to savor this exquisite experience of cheesy delight. Alternatively, embark on a flavorful adventure and roll the dice for a delectable drink that promises to energize your day like never before. Feeling adventurous? Grab the mic and unleash your inner comedian, songbird, or entertainer extraordinaire. The stage is yours to own! If mornings aren't your thing or you've burned the midnight oil, why not join us for a pick-me-up coffee and delightful conversation to start your day right? And remember--Stay Cheezy

*More: https://cheezyoasis.com/*

## Church of Chill

**Where:** D & 7:45 · **From:** Salt Lake City · **Landmark:** Blue shade structure with Church of Chill sign · **Year:** 2026

Come be Chill and enjoy a drink at our misted and shaded chapel. Leave a confession for others to read. Divinity and anhidrosis for all!

## Cicadia

**Where:** E & 7:15 · **From:** Salt Lake City · **Landmark:** Bug wings on shade tiedowns, Big Cicadia sign · **Year:** 2026

This nature and bug themed camp is buzzing with excitement and fun. The sweet sounds of music will draw you in like bugs to nectar. You can rest in the shaded nooks and comfy seats, quench your thirst with cold electrolytes, or dance the night away on the beautifully lit dancefloor.

*More: https://www.instagram.com/cicadia_ut?igsh=MTBla282em43b3NOZA==*

## Cognitive Research Institute

**Where:** C & 7:15 · **From:** Santa Cruz · **Landmark:** Green eye flag, Cognitive Research Institute sign · **Year:** 2026

Would you like a quick memory screening? We can help you make sure you'll actually remember this week. The Cognitive Research Institute has deployed a desert station to conduct daily field studies on human memory from a fully shaded research station staffed by clipboard-wielding statisticians in lab coats. Drop in during the week for a cognitive assessment and maybe a brain massage or two. Submit an unwanted memory for ceremonial destruction in the MDU-7, our clinical apparatus that is proven to be 100% effective except for ????????? and ???????????????????. Monday: memory journaling. Wednesday: memory auction. Friday: Memory Burn ceremony. The tone is institutional, the forms are voluminous and the experience is real. Walk-ins welcome. Walk-outs vary.

*More: https://starsailorart.com/cri*

## Comfort & Joy

**Where:** 7:00 & E · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** dayglo flags, structures, and beacon · **Year:** 2026

Step through our glowing portal into a queer wonderland of dayglo art, towering flags, and immersive light. At the heart of camp, Afterglow is a 24 7 space for connection, intimacy, and exploration, while our vibrant courtyard hosts performances, workshops, and high energy dance. Visit the Pink Gym, a fully equipped outdoor gym and home of Naked Oil Wrestling. Join us for drag shows, participatory events, and spontaneous moments of play. Whether you come to connect, express, or transform, Comfort and Joy offers an open, welcoming space for all adults to engage, explore, and belong.

*More: https://www.cnj.world*

## Contraptionists

**Where:** 7:00 & B · **From:** Reno · **Landmark:** White diamond w/ colored ball & lit tower · **Year:** 2026

Join us, 1 to 3 PM, for our afternoon parties with Snowcones and FireFries. Over heated kids can ask if we have ice anytime to cool off their little Brains. (Any age in destress will be helped.) Check the schedule for having your reading done. or just come cool off in the shade and watch the world go by.

## Costco Soulmate Trading Outlet

**Where:** 7:30 G Plaza @ 2:45 · **From:** Portland · **Landmark:** Large army tents with COSTCO sign at entrance · **Year:** 2026

The playa's original and longest-running soulmate trading outpost. Come experience our unparalleled matching system, honed over 27 years of no-frills soulmate trading. Trained interviewers dig deep to find your perfect match ? whether that's a new best friend, a kindred spirit, or someone who challenges everything you thought you knew. Interviews & Shenanigans Monday through Friday. Bring a soul to trade.

*More: https://www.csto.org/*

## Cult of the Magic Lady

**Where:** A & 7:15 · **From:** Oakland · **Landmark:** Large sign that says "Cult of the Magic Lady" · **Year:** 2026

Come to our Cult, we have snacks! The snacks are babies, but don't worry, they are alcoholic. We also have a church, for your physical wellbeing and personal gains. And we feed on your shame. We also have a library.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/cultofthemagiclady/*

## Deep C

**Where:** 7:30 Portal · **From:** Seattle · **Landmark:** "Deep C" sign and large LED dome · **Year:** 2026

Deep C presents: HypnoDrome — a dazzling 26-foot dome lit by over 25,000 LEDs! Step into the light and get lost in an immersive sea of color, rhythm, and movement. By day, it's a shaded oasis to relax, chill, and connect. By night, it transforms into a vibrant beacon of sound and light—perfect for dancing, lounging, or just being hypnotized by the show. Come drift in the Deep.

*More: http://campdeepc.com*

**Where:** D & 7:15 · **From:** Brooklyn, Gothenburg, LA · **Landmark:** Massive 20-sided dice archway · **Year:** 2026

## DIPTOWN

**Where:** C & 7:45 · **From:** Moscow, Russia · **Landmark:** diptown sign on pergola · **Year:** 2026

Discover the essence of Eastern Europe at BARBORIS, where we serve only the finest Russian, Ukrainian, and Eastern European vodkas. Our cozy, intimate bar offers a unique experience with dozens of vodka brands, each served in ice-cold shot glasses for the perfect chill. Immerse yourself in the authentic atmosphere, savor the rich flavors, and participate in traditional drinking rituals. Learn what sets traditional vodka apart from the rest. Join us at BARBORIS for a journey of taste and tradition, where every sip tells a tale

*More: https://shminke.art/camp.php*

## Dome on the Range

**Where:** 7:30 B Plaza @ 1:30 · **From:** San Francisco · **Landmark:** Black and White Saloon · **Year:** 2026

Yeehaw! We're your Dome away from Home! Slingin' mystery drinks and curious cures for all that ails ya. We're the weird neighborhood waterin' hole you keep comin' back to. Whether just starting your night or wandering your weary way home, come saddle up to the bar; we've got a cure for all that ails ya.

## Don't STOP

**Where:** E & 7:15 · **From:** San Mateo · **Landmark:** White shade structure with the Don't Stop banner · **Year:** 2026

Black Rock City is a place where small things can derail your day or night and we want to support our fellow burners by offering small necessities [ex. tampons, condoms, sunscreen, or glowy things] from our Don't STOP Gift Box, or a drink with inspired conversation. Additionally, we offer opportunities to restore through Yoga and breathwork and learn how to repair your bike.

## Down Low Club

**Where:** D & 7:15 · **From:** Palm Springs · **Landmark:** 16' long DOWN LOW CLUB sign & big green Army tent · **Year:** 2026

Host of annual LGBTQ+ MEET & GREET on opening Monday night since 2012, LITTLE BLACK DRESS PARTY on Tuesday evening and TV/MOVIE THEMED PARTY on Thursday afternoon. Also, since 2009, hosting the 24/7 interactivity in our DOWN LOW CLUB TENT, providing a discreet, enclosed and air-conditioned space for erotic play between consenting 18+ adult men & male-identified individuals.

*More: https://www.facebook.com/groups/DownLowClub*
